title: XP and Level-Up Tracker
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=achievement:life
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(xp) as weekly_xp by _time
| streamstats sum(weekly_xp) as total_xp
| eval level=floor(sqrt(total_xp/100))
| sort - _time
description: Turns your real-life accomplishments into experience points and levels, gamifying self-improvement.
value: A game layer makes the slow work of building a good life feel rewarding in the moment.
implementation: Ingest achievement events into `index=personal`; total XP and compute your level.
visualization: Line chart of cumulative XP with level milestones.
grandmaExplanation: It turns the good things you do into points and levels, making self-improvement feel like a game.
